CREATE FUNCTION observe_output(value integer) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS $$ SELECT nextval('output_checks') > 0 AND value >= 0 $$
CREATE DOMAIN checked_output AS integer CHECK (observe_output(VALUE))
CREATE FUNCTION checked_body(value integer) RETURNS checked_output LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS 'SELECT value'
SELECT i, checked_body(i) AS value FROM generate_series(1,3) AS t(i) ORDER BY i
CREATE FUNCTION body_inputs(OUT label text, IN value integer) LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS 'SELECT value::text'
SELECT i, body_inputs(i) AS label FROM generate_series(1,3) AS t(i) ORDER BY i
CREATE TYPE body_pair AS (id integer, label text)
CREATE FUNCTION whole_pair(value integer) RETURNS body_pair LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS 'SELECT ROW(value, value::text)::body_pair'
CREATE FUNCTION tuple_pair(value integer) RETURNS body_pair LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS 'SELECT value, value::text'
SELECT i, (whole_pair(i)).id AS whole_id, (whole_pair(i)).label AS whole_label, (tuple_pair(i)).id AS tuple_id, (tuple_pair(i)).label AS tuple_label FROM generate_series(1,3) AS t(i) ORDER BY i
